verdict.rationale: Mirrors lets teams define routing conditions that, once activated, automatically inject context edits into live agent conversations with no redeploy or code change. Routing runs locally and unattended, which is a narrow form of rule-triggered background automation (docs-2, docs-6, docs-7, docs-3). It is not a general automation feature: humans still write the context, review traces, and decide keep/revise/rollback (docs-1, docs-4, docs-9). Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automations or workflows, scheduled or background jobs, autonomous action beyond context injection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
